title: Treatment of Severe Male Infertility - Predictive Factors (Imaging)
brief_summary: Testes of men with non-obstructive azoospermia (NOA) are imaged using MRI to find potential differences depending on the outcome, ie. sperm recovery in consequent microdissection testicular sperm extraction (MD-TESE).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* non obstructive azospermia

Exclusion Criteria:

* malignancy
* contraindication for fertility treatment
